meta.title: Kundali Milan — Free Marriage Matching (36 Guna)
meta.description: Match the boy's and girl's kundali by the traditional Ashtakoot Guna Milan: 36-point score, Nadi, Bhakoot and Manglik check.

title: Kundali Milan
lead: Enter the boy's and girl's birth details. We calculate both charts exactly and match them by the traditional Ashtakoot method.
name: Name
fixFields: Please fill all the details for both.
error: Couldn't calculate the match right now. Please try again.
cancelled: Present, but cancelled by a classical exception.
nadiPresent: Present — traditionally needs remedies; consult the Jyotish.
bhakootPresent: Present — affects harmony and finances; consult the Jyotish.

manglikMatch.one: Only one is Manglik — consult the Jyotish for remedies.
manglikMatch.both: Both are Manglik — this traditionally balances out.

verdictText.excellent: A highly compatible pairing by the traditional measure.
verdictText.good: A good, compatible pairing — most qualities match well.
verdictText.average: Acceptable (18+ points). Look at the doshas below and discuss with the Jyotish.
verdictText.low: Below 18 points — traditionally not recommended without a detailed consultation.

consultNote: Guna Milan is one part of matching. A complete decision also considers the full charts, dashas and doshas — our Jyotish can review both kundalis for you.

gana.name: Gana (6)
gana.meaning: Temperament — how naturally you get along.

nadi.name: Nadi (8)
nadi.meaning: Health and progeny — the most important guna.

element.same: Both Moon signs share the same element — a naturally easy understanding of each other's feelings.
element.complement: Your Moon signs' elements complement each other (fire–air or earth–water) — different styles that support each other well.
element.effort: Your Moon signs' elements differ in style — understanding grows with patience and open talk.

compareTitle: Both of you, side by side
muhuratLead: The next four marriage muhurats for this couple, at the bride's birthplace.
muhuratNote: DRAFT — checked for marriage nakshatra, tithi, weekday, Kharmas/Chaturmas, Jupiter & Venus not combust, and both partners' Moon. Please confirm the exact lagna time with our Jyotish.
timeExact: Birth time missing — but the guna score is exact: the Moon stayed in one nakshatra that whole day.
timeRange: Birth time missing — likely score shown; it can be anywhere from {min} to {max}.
timeNote: With the exact birth time the score becomes 100% accurate (and Manglik can be checked). Don't know it? Try our Birth Time Finder.
manglikNeedsTime: Manglik check needs the birth time
kootUncertain: Depends on the unknown birth time

biodata.drop: Drop the biodata here, or tap to upload
biodata.types: PDF, JPG or PNG — we read name, birth date, time and place
biodata.filled: Filled from the biodata — please check the details.
biodata.off: Biodata reading is not switched on yet — please fill the details by hand.
biodata.error: Couldn't read this file. Try a clearer photo or a PDF.
biodata.privacy: The file is only read to fill the form and is not stored.
